description: This source file defines the HiveThriftServer2EventManager class and related event case classes for managing and broadcasting ThriftServer events within Spark's UI module.

classes.name: HiveThriftServer2EventManager
classes.description: Manages ThriftServer events, converting them into listener events and posting to the Spark listener bus.

classes.name: SparkListenerThriftServerSessionCreated
classes.description: Event indicating a ThriftServer session has been created.

classes.name: SparkListenerThriftServerSessionClosed
classes.description: Event indicating a ThriftServer session has been closed.

classes.name: SparkListenerThriftServerOperationStart
classes.description: Event indicating a ThriftServer operation has started.

classes.name: SparkListenerThriftServerOperationParsed
classes.description: Event indicating a ThriftServer operation has been parsed.

classes.name: SparkListenerThriftServerOperationCanceled
classes.description: Event indicating a ThriftServer operation has been canceled.

classes.name: SparkListenerThriftServerOperationTimeout
classes.description: Event indicating a ThriftServer operation has timed out.

classes.name: SparkListenerThriftServerOperationError
classes.description: Event indicating an error occurred during a ThriftServer operation.

classes.name: SparkListenerThriftServerOperationFinish
classes.description: Event indicating a ThriftServer operation has finished.

classes.name: SparkListenerThriftServerOperationClosed
classes.description: Event indicating a ThriftServer operation has been closed.

methods.name: postLiveListenerBus
methods.description: Posts an event to the Spark listener bus.

methods.name: onSessionCreated
methods.description: Handles session creation event, posts to listener bus.

methods.name: onSessionClosed
methods.description: Handles session closure event, posts to listener bus.

methods.name: onStatementStart
methods.description: Handles statement start event, posts to listener bus.

methods.name: onStatementParsed
methods.description: Handles statement parsed event, posts to listener bus.

methods.name: onStatementCanceled
methods.description: Handles statement canceled event, posts to listener bus.

methods.name: onStatementTimeout
methods.description: Handles statement timeout event, posts to listener bus.

methods.name: onStatementError
methods.description: Handles statement error event, posts to listener bus.

methods.name: onStatementFinish
methods.description: Handles statement finish event, posts to listener bus.

methods.name: onOperationClosed
methods.description: Handles operation closed event, posts to listener bus.
